features.name: Payment details on invoices
features.description: Workspace-level payment instructions (bank transfer, PayPal, PayID) with optional per-invoice override, rendered on the public invoice page and PDF.

subtasks.name: Migration: add payment_methods jsonb columns to workspaces and invoices
Regenerate DB types and create shared payment-method Zod schema/types
Update workspace service, Server Action, and settings loader for payment methods
Settings form: add reusable payment-method editor UI
Invoice module: persist and resolve payment methods (workspace default vs invoice override)
Invoice form: add payment-instructions override UI
Extend invoice Server Action schemas with paymentMethods
Public invoice page: render resolved payment methods
Invoice PDF: render resolved payment methods
Unit tests for payment-method validation and resolution
Integration tests for workspace settings + invoice override
Integration tests for public page and PDF route
Seed data: add demo workspace payment methods

acceptanceCriteria: Workspace owner/admin can add, edit, remove, and re-order payment methods in /settings/general.
Supported method types: bank transfer (account name, BSB, account number, bank name, reference), PayPal (email), PayID (identifier).
Each invoice can use the workspace default or override with custom payment instructions.
Public invoice /i/[token] shows resolved payment methods when the invoice is payable.
When Stripe is configured, payment methods appear as an alternative to card payment; when absent, they become the primary payment path.
Invoice PDF download includes the resolved payment methods.
Malformed or unsupported payment-method JSON is rejected at the server boundary.
pnpm check (type-check + lint + test:ci) passes after implementation.
